verdict.rationale: DPMA is the German patent and trade mark office, a government authority. Its core offering is official registration, examination and register services (DEPATISnet, DPMAregister, the e-filing routes), and these cannot be self-hosted by a user, so self-hosting is a category error for this kind of product. The free downloadable DPMAdirektPro software is only a local tool for preparing filings, not a self-hostable instance of the core service, so it does not make the axis apply.
